setup.title: SAS Portal Initial Setup
setup.description: Verify the LDAP connection and define the first administrator user to continue.

helpers.bindUserName: DOMAIN\user or user@domain.local format is recommended.
helpers.bindUserDomain: Optional. Enter if bind user domain is stored separately.
helpers.userSearchFilter: {0} is replaced with the user name.
helpers.ldapsHelp: Connections are established over LDAPS (SSL/TLS) on port 636.
helpers.adminCredentials: This user is validated against LDAP and becomes the portal SuperAdmin after setup. Display name and email are loaded from the AD profile.

messages.directoryUserNotFoundHint: The administrator user could not be found in AD. Try the user name as sAMAccountName, DOMAIN\user, or user@domain and check the User Search Filter setting.
messages.directoryUserProfileHint: The administrator user's AD profile could not be loaded. Check the user name, User Search Base, and User Search Filter settings.
messages.ldapTimeoutHint: The setup request timed out or the LDAP server did not respond. Check the LDAP server, network connectivity, and User Search settings.
